title: Old agreement with non-human beings from the Truman–Eisenhower era

tellings.quote: that that is the nature of at least one very old agreement um sometime in the Truman and Eisenhower era uh that was arrived at.

plain: Matthew Brown, who describes himself as a Pentagon whistleblower, says he has been told of at least one very old agreement between the US and non-human beings, made sometime in the era of Presidents Truman and Eisenhower, between 1945 and 1961. If true, it would mean the US government has had a secret pact with non-human beings for decades.
